newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates lower across the board.

text.p: The Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) mellowed in all maturities on Monday in line with the soft trend in interest rates, traders said.
"Banks are anticipating a downward trend in interest rates," a foreign bank dealer said, in view of the high liquidity in the market.
She said banks were expecting an announcement from Moody's Investors Service on a credit upgrade for the Philippines after Standard and Poor's Corp did so two weeks ago.
That would bring more foreign funds into the country, which would make the system more liquid, she said.
